shortDescription: Collects Ethernet device statistics using the entstat command on AIX

options.name: concatenated_output
options.description: Controls whether the output is appended to the file or overwrites it.

options.name: debug_trace
options.description: Toggles debug trace in some device drivers (-t).

options.name: device_name
options.description: Name of the Ethernet device (for example, ent0).

options.name: device_statistics
options.description: Displays all statistics, including device-specific statistics (-d).

options.name: recorded_output
options.description: Path to file where command output should be written.

options.name: reset_stats
options.description: Resets all statistics back to initial values (-r). Only privileged users can issue this flag.
